mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.6.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 195.0) and stagnant monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 3.6) indicates a failure to control inflation, which erodes corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both CPIAUCSL > 195.0 and FEDFUNDS < 3.6.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts below 2000 thousand units signals a weakening real estate market, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST falls below 2000.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, as higher manufacturing output supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC (correlation between INDPRO and 60d SPX returns) is negative or below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 150,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 2000) and retail sales (RSAFS < 350000) indicates a weakening consumer sector, which reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST < 2000 and RSAFS < 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% within the last month signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
